verdict.rationale: Kling documents generation from image and video inputs: image-to-video with start/end frames, video generation with video input, and an MVL framework that treats image and video as input modalities. That covers pointing at a reference to generate new footage. None of the evidence explicitly describes taking the style of a reference and applying it to new content, so the 'in that style' part is only implied. missing for 10: explicit style-reference/style-transfer documentation, detail on how reference video input is used, independent or hands-on corroboration.
